import sympy as sp

def test_linearity(state_update, output, n_sym=sp.symbols('n')):
    # state_update: function(q,u,n)->q_next ; output: function(q,n)->y
    q1,q2,u1,u2,a,b = sp.symbols('q1 q2 u1 u2 a b')
    n = n_sym
    # linearity of state map in (q,u) with constant coeffs
    # check additivity: f(q1+q2,u1+u2) == f(q1,u1)+f(q2,u2)
    lhs = state_update(q1+q2, u1+u2, n)
    rhs = state_update(q1,u1,n)+state_update(q2,u2,n)
    add_ok = sp.simplify(lhs-rhs)==0
    # homogeneity
    hom_lhs = state_update(a*q1, a*u1, n)
    hom_rhs = a*state_update(q1,u1,n)
    hom_ok = sp.simplify(hom_lhs-hom_rhs)==0
    # output linearity
    out_add = sp.simplify(output(q1+q2,n)-(output(q1,n)+output(q2,n)))==0
    out_hom = sp.simplify(output(a*q1,n)-a*output(q1,n))==0
    return add_ok, hom_ok, out_add, out_hom
